title: Concept: Cookie written from script without the Secure attribute in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, a cookie is written from script. Cookies created this way are always readable by script, so an XSS becomes immediate session theft when the value is a token. Without Secure the same value also crosses plaintext requests, which is invisible in a browser that upgrades silently.
applicability: javascript browser applications that store state in cookies.
risk: Session theft and cleartext cookie disclosure; MEDIUM severity.
